'''Docking Bay 21''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kynachi]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] used this hangar as a staging area during an operation on Kynachi around the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
